newsitem.title: UK: No change for Billiton's LME ring status -Gencor.
newsitem.headline: No change for Billiton's LME ring status -Gencor.

text.p: No plans exist to change the London Metal Exchange (LME) ring membership of Billiton Metals when South Africa's Gencor Ltd floats its base metals interests in London, Gencor Finance Director Mick Davis said on Wednesday.
Gencor said on Wednesday is planned to list this summer its non-precious metals operations as a new company, Billiton plc, and raise $1 billion in Britain, the U.S. and Europe.
"We have no plans to change our (LME) membership," Davis told a meeting of mining analysts in London. Davis is due to become director of finance, coal and human resources at the new firm.

Speculation has been rife in London over whether any other firms would give up their LME ring-dealing status after Deutsche Morgan Grenfell did so earlier this month and Lehman Brother Commodities quit the floor last November.
The decision by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell stemmed from a move to refocus operations, it said.
